card.title: Owner
card.skillDescription: Who this skill belongs to. Team and organisation skills can be used by all members and edited by everyone allowed to manage them.
card.knowledgeBaseDescription: Who this knowledge base belongs to. Team and organisation knowledge bases can be used by all members and edited by everyone allowed to manage them.

change.title: Change owner
change.toPersonal: {{name}} becomes yours alone. Everyone else loses access.
change.toTeam: {{name}} moves to the team {{team}}. Only its members keep access.
change.toOrg: {{name}} moves to the organisation. All its members get access.
change.skillLinksWarning_one: The link to {{count}} knowledge base with a different owner will be removed.
change.skillLinksWarning_other: The links to {{count}} knowledge bases with a different owner will be removed.
change.knowledgeBaseLinksWarning_one: The link from {{count}} skill with a different owner will be removed.
change.knowledgeBaseLinksWarning_other: The links from {{count}} skills with a different owner will be removed.
change.error: The owner could not be changed
change.duplicateName: The new owner already has a skill with this name
change.noPermission: You are not allowed to move it to this owner
change.notFound: It no longer exists or you have lost access

activation.managedByOwner: Switches it for everyone with access
